messages:
tara-recruiter: Quick FYI — noticed several calendar invites for today’s interviews have no rubric link / attachments. Candidates are there, but interviewers only see a blank 'prep' section. Anyone else seeing this?

sam-peopleops: Yep, we got a flood of pings from interviewers this morning. Looks like the ATS webhook started sending a different key for interview materials after last night's deploy.

maria-sre-bot: Deploy bot: webhook-transformer v3.1 deployed at 06:12 UTC. No errors in HTTP status, but schema validation warnings: missing field 'prep_documents'. Logged as WARN id=wt-4821.

alex-eng: Confirmed on our side — transformer accepted payload but the new schema uses `interviewerMaterials` (array) vs legacy `prep_documents` (string link). Our calendar generator still reads `prep_documents`.

tara-recruiter: Is this a rollback or a quick patch we can do? We have 18 interviews in the next 3 hours that need rubrics.

sam-peopleops: We can send the rubric links manually but that's a ton of manual steps. Is there a safe hotfix to map the new key to the old one?

alex-eng: Yeah, small runtime change in the transformer: if `interviewerMaterials` present and `prep_documents` missing, set `prep_documents` = join(interviewerMaterials, "\n"). I can push a hotfix to canary now.

maria-sre-bot: Can deploy to canary in 8 minutes. Current deploy queue length: 2.

jenna-interviewer-coordinator: If we do a canary patch, please also send a bulk-update to calendar invites so interviewers get refreshed attachments — some clients cache the invite body.

tara-recruiter: Also need to make sure the rubric version is the latest (v2.3). We had interviewers referencing the old rubric last week; don't want mixed versions.

alex-eng: Good catch. The transformer has access to candidate metadata which includes `rubric_version`. I'll default to v2.3 when mapping. If missing, fallback to the most recent published.

ops-bot: Runbook step suggestion: 1) Patch transformer to map fields (canary), 2) Trigger calendar refresh job for impacted interviews, 3) Notify interviewers with manual fallback link if refresh fails.

sam-peopleops: I'll draft the notification and bulk calendar update script. Can we get the canary patch before 09:00 PT?

alex-eng: On it. Pushing branch `hotfix/transformer-interviewer-materials` now. ETA 15m for canary, 45m for full rollout if no regression.

maria-sre-bot: Canary deployed at 06:37 UTC. Monitoring logs for schema warnings.

jenna-interviewer-coordinator: Thanks — once canary looks good, please run a calendar refresh for these interview IDs: 8791, 8792, 8793, 8794, 8800. I’ll stand by to DM interviewers the v2.3 rubric if any still miss it.

tara-recruiter: Appreciate the quick turnaround. After this incident, can we add a simple E2E check that verifies the calendar invite contains a rubric link for each interview created? Would save a bunch of manual steps.

alex-eng: Agreed. I'll add a lightweight integration test in the webhook CI that asserts presence of `prep_documents` in generated calendar payloads for a sample candidate.

sam-peopleops: I'll also update our interviewer onboarding checklist to include a note about verifying rubric version in calendar.

ops-bot: Incident closed for now: hotfix applied and calendar refresh queued. Reopen if any interviewers report missing materials. :white_check_mark:
